segments.text: ALmightie God, whiche haſte geuen ſuche grace to thy Apoſtle ſaincte Andrewe, that he counted the ſharpe and painful death of the croſſe to be an high honour, and a great glory: Graunt vs to take & eſteme al troubles and aduerſities whiche ſhall come vnto vs for thy ſake, as thinges profitable for vs toward the obtayning of euerlaſting lyfe: through Ieſus Chriſte our Lorde.
